headline: Ai Weiwei Setting Up Lego Collection Points After Company Refuses His Order
snippet: The Chinese artist and dissident said that the Lego Group had rejected an order for several million Lego bricks that would have been used to create works for an exhibition titled “Andy Warhol | Ai Weiwei,” scheduled to open on Dec. 11 at the National Gallery of Victoria in Australia.
